category.title: ActionScript 2
category.description: Tracked families of language features and Flash APIs. The completed share of this registry is not a percentage of Flash Player compatibility.

features.title: Source diagnostics
features.scope: Parse errors and unsupported frontend constructs report the language, line and column; compilation errors block export.
features.limitations: This guarantees compiler diagnostics, not verification of every Flash API semantic.

features.title: Literals
features.scope: Decimal, hexadecimal and exponent numbers; strings; Boolean, null, undefined, NaN and Infinity; arrays without holes and object literals.
features.limitations: The full set of literals and historical Flash rules is not implemented; legacy numbers with leading zeroes are rejected.

features.title: Variables and scope
features.scope: var, multiple declarations, handler-owner fields, and hoisting of local var declarations and parameters. The two-hour AS2 batch adds the publication-owned _global namespace and Rust-validated named eval/set paths across supported lexical, root, level-zero, parent and timeline references.
features.limitations: Handler fields differ from classes and the full Flash scope chain; top-level declarations follow documented reinitialization rules. Named lookup is not arbitrary source evaluation; aliases and unsupported path expressions remain outside the profile.

features.title: Arithmetic, logic and assignments
features.scope: Basic arithmetic, comparisons, short-circuit evaluation, bitwise operations, ++/-- and compound assignments. Membership and member/index deletion preserve original container keys; indexed compound/update writes evaluate receiver and key once. The bounded AS2-only delivery and exact declaration profiles are recorded in docs/AS2-LEGACY-BATCH.md. Deprecated string/Boolean/inequality operators now use the Rust AS2 service.
features.limitations: Some operations use JavaScript coercion; this is not complete AVM semantics across all Flash Player versions.

features.title: If/else branches
features.scope: Parsing and execution of if/else, blocks and the conditional expression ?:, selecting one branch.
features.limitations: This covers control flow in the supported frontend; conversion of arbitrary Flash objects remains part of unfinished type compatibility.

features.title: Classic loops and jumps
features.scope: while, do/while, three-part for, and nested break/continue with jump-target validation.
features.limitations: for..in property enumeration and full compatibility of condition coercion are tracked separately. Independent a3fedc3 browser evidence covers the specific class/input scenarios in VERIFICATION.md; all untested members remain bounded or unverified.

features.title: Switch and fallthrough
features.scope: Single evaluation of the subject, sequential case matching, default, fallthrough and break.
features.limitations: The supported contract uses strict comparison; compatibility across Flash Player versions is not certified.

features.title: Function declarations and calls
features.scope: Function declarations/expressions, recursion, callbacks and lexical captures; supplied arguments, call/apply forwarding and dynamic explicit receivers. Project methods remain shared unbound functions, with the existing captured timeline-owner convention for handler names.
features.limitations: Declarations must be directly inside a function or handler body. Default/rest source syntax, arguments.caller, runtime-built Function code, full prototype/reflection and complete AVM1 scope/global receiver behavior remain unsupported or unverified. Null/undefined unbound receivers use the documented NeoFlash source-frame convention. Independent 11a59df evidence (FUNCTIONS-HTML5-20261027T0914Z) covers the observed dynamic receivers/shared method identity, supplied counts and independent AS2 command values 0/21→5/21→9/21, followed by fresh Restart. AS3 optional/rest or typed arity checks do not promote AS2 syntax or full AVM1 behavior.

features.title: Closures and variable capture
features.scope: Lexical local variables, shadowing, closures retained after return, and capture of the handler owner.
features.limitations: The complete Flash receiver, global-object and scope-chain models are not implemented.

features.title: Function parameters and returns
features.scope: Positional parameters with erased AS2 annotations; omitted normal values stay undefined and supplied arguments retain their values. Bounded argument arrays and call/apply use the same dynamic receiver profile as source functions.
features.limitations: AS2 default/rest source syntax remains unsupported. Supplied arguments and bounded call/apply now have a separate function-family profile; full AVM1 invocation/coercion/error semantics remain unproven. Independent 11a59df evidence (FUNCTIONS-HTML5-20261027T0914Z) covers the observed dynamic receivers/shared method identity, supplied counts and independent AS2 command values 0/21→5/21→9/21, followed by fresh Restart. AS3 optional/rest or typed arity checks do not promote AS2 syntax or full AVM1 behavior.

features.title: this and method binding
features.scope: Frame/object handlers retain their owner. Declared AS2 class methods are shared and unbound, using their actual call receiver; function expressions can use explicit dynamic this. Listener callbacks retain their listener object.
features.limitations: Bare owner fields in older handler closures still use the captured timeline owner. Complete AVM1 scope-chain/global-receiver semantics and reflection remain incomplete. Independent 11a59df evidence (FUNCTIONS-HTML5-20261027T0914Z) covers the observed dynamic receivers/shared method identity, supplied counts and independent AS2 command values 0/21→5/21→9/21, followed by fresh Restart. AS3 optional/rest or typed arity checks do not promote AS2 syntax or full AVM1 behavior.

features.title: Annotations and type system
features.scope: Selected primitive and resolved project-class annotations are accepted and erased. AS2 class fields without initializers default to undefined; writes do not acquire AS3-style slot coercion. LoadVars annotations are accepted and erased; its hidden constructor binding does not replace local source bindings.
features.limitations: There is no complete AS2 static type checker or VM coercion model. Erased class annotations intentionally do not enforce assignment types at runtime. Independent c39a29e acceptance (RESOURCES-HTML5-20261027T0323Z) covers the precise embedded/HTTP and pending-request observations in VERIFICATION.md; native resource authoring and full network semantics remain unverified.

features.title: Throw, catch and finally
features.scope: Explicit throw preserving the payload, untyped catch and catch(Error), finally and rethrow.
features.limitations: AS2 catch does not intercept native JavaScript/host errors; catch bindings and variable capture have restrictions.

features.title: Error objects
features.scope: A limited new Error facade, message and toString.
features.limitations: General class construction, getStackTrace, complete prototype semantics and all Flash error codes are absent.

features.title: Classes, inheritance and interfaces
features.scope: One qualified class per matching source path; public/default instance/static members, scalar prototype defaults, same-dialect inheritance/super, shared unbound writable methods and constructor-created objects. Existing instances observe prototype method replacement. AS2 private declarations include subclass access and retain ordinary runtime string/prototype representation; known typed/static invalid dot access receives compile-time diagnostics. The bounded AS2-only delivery and exact declaration profiles are recorded in docs/AS2-INTERFACES-BATCH.md. AS2 source interfaces, a single interface parent, multiple implements and exact method signatures reuse the owned Rust linker.
features.limitations: Interface accessors, non-scalar inline defaults, mixed-dialect inheritance, class-as-function casts and unsupported super value extraction diagnose. Complete prototype/reflection, construction and static initialization order are pending. Independent a3fedc3 browser evidence covers the specific class/input scenarios in VERIFICATION.md; all untested members remain bounded or unverified. The linked-movieclips ordinary-export/real-WASM host scenario passes; representative interactions and Restart also passed in the shared in-app-browser batch; VERIFICATION.md distinguishes visible evidence from host-only checks. Independent 798e28b evidence (LINKED-INTERFACES-HTML5-20261027T0243Z) applies only to the linked timeline and interface/accessor observations in VERIFICATION.md. AS2 host-error catch recovery, complete construction order and uncalled members remain unverified or outside the supported profile. The source-class/package delivery has its own bounded evidence; generalized static typing, custom namespaces, native overrides and complete initialization/reflection/VM conformance remain open. Independent 6687ced evidence (CLASSES-HTML5-20261027T1007Z) is limited to the observed subclass updating its inherited private field 20/23/26 and Restart 20/23 in VERIFICATION.md. It does not imply AS3 runtime secrecy, arbitrary external-access diagnostics or full prototype/initialization semantics.

features.title: Imports and project linking
features.scope: Embedded AS2 sources support exact imports, same-package/qualified resolution and linked authored symbols. Class source paths match qualified names; the root document_class option is a NeoFlash extension. Explicit library linkage IDs connect runtime creation to authored MovieClip symbols; exported linked classes must ultimately extend MovieClip. Immediate-package wildcard imports resolve embedded same-dialect types; AS3 internal class visibility is package-scoped and name collisions diagnose.
features.limitations: Mixed-dialect imports, ambient filesystem/module loading and SWC dependencies are unsupported. Source compilation does not add FLA/XFL linkage extraction or a complete legacy linker. The linked-movieclips ordinary-export/real-WASM host scenario passes; representative interactions and Restart also passed in the shared in-app-browser batch; VERIFICATION.md distinguishes visible evidence from host-only checks. Independent 6687ced evidence (CLASSES-HTML5-20261027T1007Z) extends the positive embedded legacy.* import path used by the inherited-private counter. Ambiguity, exact-import precedence, subpackage expansion and external dependencies were not independently browser-tested.

features.title: Dynamic objects and prototypes
features.scope: Object literals and project instances retain actual references. The AS2 two-hour batch adds watch/unwatch, computed addProperty accessors, isPropertyEnumerable and missing-property __resolve. Rust owns watchpoint identity, lifetime and reentry guards; the host invokes original callbacks and keeps references. Named eval/set lookup connects these objects to the publication namespace.
features.limitations: This is not a complete AVM1 Object/prototype/scope-chain model. Watchpoints on arrays, native objects and existing native/accessor properties, arbitrary prototype mutation and every legacy coercion/lookup interaction remain unsupported. Object31/31 and Restart were observed in the ordinary HTML5 example; native host failures are not swallowed by the AS2 authored-throw catch profile.

features.title: Property enumeration and with
features.scope: Bounded for-in property enumeration over ordinary records, Arrays and project objects; original-key membership and member/index deletion. AS2 variable annotations retain their erased profile.
features.limitations: Snapshot keys ignore later insertions, skip deletions and read values at visit time. Historical iteration order, with, XML/E4X and enumeration of hidden native/display storage remain unsupported. The combined typed-collections workflow supplies delivery evidence separately; this is not a full Flash enumeration contract. Independent 6396fd0 evidence (TYPED-COLLECTIONS-HTML5-20261027T0525Z) covers only the ordinary AS2 record for-in total in the inventory scenario and its Restart in VERIFICATION.md. It does not imply AS2 native Vector/Dictionary/for-each, native-storage enumeration or general historical enumeration order.

features.title: Additional language operators
features.scope: Existing comma, void, in and member/index delete, plus supported native/project construction. The AS2 hour reviews existing comma/void/delete behavior and adds legacy operators; see docs/AS2-LEGACY-BATCH.md. The two-hour batch adds instanceof against statically resolved supported project/native types; its ordinary Object example exercises the bounded source path.
features.limitations: Arbitrary constructor expressions, prototype-mutation conformance and boxed/native construction remain outside this profile. No full AVM/version parity.

features.title: Primitives and global conversions
features.scope: Number, Boolean, parseFloat, isNaN and isFinite retain JavaScript-backed conversions. String now uses the bounded primitive family facade; parseInt retains its separate pinned AS2 profile and earlier HTML5 acceptance. Bare getTimer() reads signed 32-bit elapsed milliseconds from the publication session clock. The bounded Rust reuse experiment adds escape/unescape and the legacy chr/ord/length/substring plus mb variants; eight legacy names share four kernels. The existing AS2 random global now calculates its range in Rust; it is included once in the 19 migrated Math/global paths. Callback setInterval/setTimeout and clearInterval/clearTimeout now share the Rust timer registry and publication lifecycle. The bounded AS2-only delivery and exact declaration profiles are recorded in docs/AS2-LEGACY-BATCH.md.
features.limitations: Complete historical coercions, boxed values and the full standard library remain unfinished. Array/String expectations are documented_only; the combined browser pipeline passed without original Flash comparison. Restart rebases the clock; historical timing equivalence is not established. The combined geometry/clock browser workflow and Restart passed. The Rust string/legacy-global profile targets SWF6+ and retains explicit surrogate URL-codec and malformed UTF-8 boundaries. No new language constructs or full VM are implied. This hour's batch remains partial; acceptance and any observed failures are recorded separately in docs/AS-RUNTIME-HOUR.md. Earlier browser evidence does not certify the new entries or full historical conformance.

features.title: Math
features.scope: A closed list of numeric Math methods, including trigonometry, abs, min/max, pow, random and round. Exact project imports also expose finite Point/Rectangle/Matrix values: point arithmetic, rectangle queries and affine matrix construction/composition/inversion/coordinate mapping. Display bounds and coordinate conversion use the same value classes. Runtime Transform/ColorTransform adds exact affine overrides, copy-valued geometry getters, skew-preserving scalar mutation, nested RGBA paint composition and independent tinted views of shared pixels. The shared Rust core now owns 18 Math methods plus the existing AS2 random global (19 migrated paths across both dialects, not new APIs), with eight constants counted separately. Point/Rectangle/Matrix/ColorTransform calculations and value state also move to Rust: the shared geometry packet migrates 74 existing method/property entries and adds 46 entries across AS2/AS3. AS2 Color supplies getRGB/setRGB/getTransform/setTransform against an existing display object.
features.limitations: Math and the migrated geometry value calculations execute in Rust/WASM; the full contract and numerical equivalence with Flash are not certified. The shared geometry profile requires finite numbers and rejects overflow/singular inversion; 3D display integration and complete historical coercion/native-slot behavior remain pending. Runtime Transform uses logical stage coordinates and bounded finite values; native script preview/authoring skew, browser-window mapping and exact raster pixelBounds are not claimed. The combined geometry/Timer browser workflow and Restart passed. The combined Transform workflow passed actual-WASM and in-app-browser Cycle/Restart; independent declaration audit and exact historical conformance remain separate. AS2 Math follows the bounded SWF7+ argument/extrema profile; exact libm results, historical RNG sequences and complete AVM numeric conversion remain partial. Color accepts object targets, rejects unresolved target paths, and uses bounded signed 8.8/16-bit transform conversion. The retained ColorTransform.concat offset order is a documented compatibility limit. This hour's batch remains partial; acceptance and any observed failures are recorded separately in docs/AS-RUNTIME-HOUR.md. Earlier browser evidence does not certify the new entries or full historical conformance.

features.title: Collections, strings, dates and data APIs
features.scope: Bounded Array constructors and mutation/slicing, comparator/flag sort and multi-field sortOn; primitive String conversion, UTF-16 access/search/slicing/splitting/concatenation/casing. Shared adapters preserve custom overrides and lookup order in handlers and project methods. AS2 Number formatting and the Array search extension remain JavaScript-backed rather than complete native AS2 contracts. Date adds current/millisecond/component construction, UTC/local getters and setters, static UTC/parse, modern browser date strings and native-branded values shared between compiled units. Fourteen existing String members now run in the shared Rust core, adapted from pinned Ruffle algorithms and historical Flash case tables. Browser acceptance covers the 24-member combined string/global scenario with rerun and Restart. Date numeric calendar/getter/setter/UTC behavior now uses the shared Rust Date service, preserving native Date identity; browser timezone resolution and locale/parser facilities remain explicit. Nonvisual Collection/Iterator, explicit DataProvider arrays, DataSet views and local delta packets now share a Rust kernel for stable IDs, sorting/filtering/ranges, independent cursors, tracked edits, cancelable writes and nested event batches. Browser references preserve item identity; ordinary data/binding HTML5 acceptance passed 14/14.
features.limitations: Partial profiles: 1,000,000 array entries/string code units or results; ordinary records, restricted sortOn options, no native method extraction/prototype augmentation, RegExp/custom string patterns, locale operations or complete historical coercion/order. AS3 NUMERIC requires numeric values; AS2 boxed String is unsupported. See fixture profile constants for exact dialect limits. The combined collection/text browser scenario passed; this does not establish every method. Date calendar arithmetic uses Rust; timezone resolution/parser/locale remain browser facilities; complete historical coercion/DST/formatting and native subclasses remain unsupported. Native RegExp and JSON are AS3-only; user AS2 classes with those names retain their ordinary resolution. Initial data-processing delivery verification is recorded separately. Independent 7ed1605 evidence (DATA-HTML5-20261027T0452Z) covers only numeric UTC Date construction/mutation/readback in the separate AS2 card and Restart, as scoped in VERIFICATION.md. It does not imply native AS2 JSON/RegExp or locale/DST/parsing conformance. The second runtime-hour delivery is partial and has representative family HTML5 acceptance, not per-declaration or original-player conformance; see docs/AS-RUNTIME-HOUR-2.md. DataSet local delta snapshots do not imply remote acknowledgement, schema/resolver support or persistence. Direct structural mutation of initialized provider arrays diagnoses; item-field changes require editField to enter the local journal. Catalogue interfaces are fulfilled by returned concrete objects rather than fake constructible interfaces.

features.title: Trace through the browser host
features.scope: trace from handlers and nested functions runs through the host, updating the console and player status line.
features.limitations: This implements the observable NeoFlash output channel; complete formatting of all Flash types is not claimed.

features.title: MovieClip and timelines
features.scope: play/stop, gotoAndPlay/gotoAndStop and nextFrame/prevFrame return undefined; current/total frames, named children and independent nested clocks remain available. AS2 labels use ASCII folding, first duplicate match and missing-label no-op; bounded numeric strings take precedence. Linked AS2 MovieClip classes retain the same captured timeline bridge and per-placement lifetime. Explicitly exported MovieClip symbols provide independent scoped authored timelines, nested clocks/scripts and linked class state; attachMovie resolves an exact export identifier at append-only depth with a bounded data-only initObject.
features.limitations: This is a limited MovieClip facade; complete construction/re-entry, scenes, unrestricted authored-list mutation and the Flash lifecycle are not implemented. Native goto aliases and complete historical numeric and lookup rules are unsupported. Independent a3fedc3 browser evidence covers the specific class/input scenarios in VERIFICATION.md; all untested members remain bounded or unverified. The linked-movieclips ordinary-export/real-WASM host scenario passes; representative interactions and Restart also passed in the shared in-app-browser batch; VERIFICATION.md distinguishes visible evidence from host-only checks. Independent 798e28b evidence (LINKED-INTERFACES-HTML5-20261027T0243Z) applies only to the linked timeline and interface/accessor observations in VERIFICATION.md. AS2 host-error catch recovery, complete construction order and uncalled members remain unverified or outside the supported profile.

features.title: Display properties
features.scope: Position, scale, alpha, bounded finite rotation readback, visibility, root/parent and AS2 aliases including _name/_width/_height. The shared facade supplies name lookup, transformed bounds/coordinates and supported nonrotated dimension changes. Runtime createEmptyMovieClip/removeMovieClip and append-only getNextHighestDepth share stable identities with the dynamic graph. Explicitly exported MovieClip symbols provide independent scoped authored timelines, nested clocks/scripts and linked class state; attachMovie resolves an exact export identifier at append-only depth with a bounded data-only initObject. MovieClip.attachBitmap adds shared runtime pixels at the current append depth. Runtime Transform/ColorTransform adds exact affine overrides, copy-valued geometry getters, skew-preserving scalar mutation, nested RGBA paint composition and independent tinted views of shared pixels. Runtime vector mask assignment and copied integral scrollRect state clip nested targets while preserving live identities; content coordinate offsets and viewport bounds share the Rust graph. Scripted HTML5 filters add copied Blur/Glow/DropShadow/ColorMatrix values, shared bounded Rust RGBA kernels and ordered whole-subtree groups, including nested effects and deferred owner mask/scroll clipping. Runtime BitmapData image processing adds color/filter operations and current subtree capture through the shared scene painter; AS3 adds bulk ByteArray transfer and PNG encoding with Loader round-trip. Shared input state adds mouseEnabled/mouseChildren, buttonMode/useHandCursor and stable hitArea references. A publication owns one copied-bounds drag operation, transformed local mouse coordinates, bounds/shape point queries and object-bound intersections. AS2 uses its numeric startDrag/hitTest overloads and local mouse/drop-path aliases. AS2 Color adds four methods for RGB and percentage/offset transforms on live display objects, reusing the Rust ColorTransform and existing paint path. This does not implement the separate historical ColorTransform.rgb finding. ConvolutionFilter, BevelFilter, GradientGlowFilter and GradientBevelFilter add forty-seven shared members in both dialects and render through the same bounded Rust pixel pipeline; BitmapFilterType supplies inner/outer/full constants. The bounded AS2-only delivery and exact declaration profiles are recorded in docs/AS2-DISPLAY-BATCH.md. The two-hour AS2 batch adds explicit enabled/focus/tab preferences, legacy input callback routes and text snapshots/surfaces. BitmapData gains channel/palette/merge/difference operations, fill/threshold/alpha hit tests, seeded noise/dissolve/Perlin, exact bundled-resource-ID loading and AS2 displacement filtering. The ordinary bitmap example passed 14/14 plus a clamp-mode change; display/text passed 41/41 with actual pointer/key/Tab observations.
features.limitations: Full MovieClip APIs, general depth management, alpha masks/remaining filters and TextField/Button contracts remain incomplete. Rotated dimension writes and noninvertible coordinate conversions diagnose; legacy rotation/visibility coercion is not full AVM1 conformance. Representative family behavior passed in the shared in-app-browser batch; this is not full API or cross-engine acceptance. Independent a3fedc3 browser evidence covers the specific class/input scenarios in VERIFICATION.md; all untested members remain bounded or unverified. Authored children cannot be moved/removed; detached runtime objects remain allocated until Restart, with a 4,096-object bound. General Flash depth replacement and full linked construction order remain unsupported. The combined dynamic-display browser workflow and Restart passed. Independent 2b5deff evidence covers only the exact dynamic drawing/identity or binary packet scenarios in VERIFICATION.md; other members and native error/coercion fidelity remain unverified. The linked-movieclips ordinary-export/real-WASM host scenario passes; representative interactions and Restart also passed in the shared in-app-browser batch; VERIFICATION.md distinguishes visible evidence from host-only checks. Independent 798e28b evidence (LINKED-INTERFACES-HTML5-20261027T0243Z) applies only to the linked timeline and interface/accessor observations in VERIFICATION.md. AS2 host-error catch recovery, complete construction order and uncalled members remain unverified or outside the supported profile. The bitmap-pixels family passes separate ordinary-export/real-WASM and in-app-browser checks for visible shared edits, source/clone independence, AS2 attachment and Restart. Native image-panel acceptance remains pending; full rasterization and coercion parity are not established. Independent 1bd0e3c evidence (BITMAP-HTML5-20261027T0345Z) is restricted to the PNG/shared pixel, AS2 attachment, disposal and Restart observations in VERIFICATION.md. JPEG, rasterization options, alpha hits and native image authoring do not inherit that pass. The combined Transform workflow passed actual-WASM and in-app-browser Cycle/Restart; independent declaration audit and exact historical conformance remain separate. Independent 852c8b7 evidence (TRANSFORMS-HTML5-20261027T0502Z) covers the specified affine/skew/reparent, tint/alpha pixels and real coordinate hits, copy ownership and Restart workflow in VERIFICATION.md. Native editing, exact rasterization, dynamic-card keyboard/accessibility and unobserved members do not inherit that pass. Canonical ColorTransform.rgb remains missing: P1 TRANSFORM-AS2-RGB-001 reproduces a silent custom-field write with unchanged green tint; the adjacent .color control produces red. Working AS2 affine stripe/rotation does not close rgb. Vector-only/static source restrictions and immediate integral scroll rectangles are explicit; native clipping authoring and historical fractional/deferred behavior remain pending. Independent 05d5d43 evidence (CLIPPING-HTML5-20261027T0652Z) covers direct-object setMask, the observed Boolean success/clear/restore and real excluded/positive legacy input, finite integral scroll offsets and the narrow absent-scrollRect undefined profile in VERIFICATION.md. AS3 copy checks do not establish AS2 getter-copy behavior. Historical return/coercion, source reuse/retirement and uncalled members remain unverified. This runtime-only filter profile has its own gallery evidence; native filter authoring, remaining classes, cacheAsBitmap, exact Flash kernels/coercions and high-density raster fidelity remain pending. Active native DOM editing under a filtered ancestor is an explicit composition boundary. Original geometry supplies input and semantics; effect halos do not extend them. Independent 5395375 evidence (FILTERS-HTML5-20261027T0844Z) covers the observed AS2 strip styles, direct clicks, clear/restore and fresh Restart counters in examples/filter-gallery.nflash. AS3 copy/value probes do not promote every AS2 filter member; complete coercion/raster behavior and native authoring remain unverified. The image pipeline remains bounded: normal draw blending, integer regions, no external mask dependencies, no display filters during draw, partial setPixels underrun, and separate native authoring/exact raster acceptance. Independent 6f4f66a evidence (IMAGE-PIPELINE-HTML5-20261027T0943Z) covers the initial AS2 clone/copy/colorTransform/Blur/applyFilter/draw path through the same AS3-created BitmapData facade and the observed visible panel. It does not establish independently created AS2-origin data, all return/error contracts or later complete console/PNG traces; the bounded source and UI evidence is separated in VERIFICATION.md. Pointer behavior is a bounded 2D browser profile: self/cyclic hitArea links reject, drag cancellation on reparenting is explicit, and exact glyph/filter/transparent-fill/historical input fidelity remains pending. AS2 trackAsMenu, multi-touch and 3D remain outside the bounded input profile. Controlled pointer events prove wiring; native browser gestures have separate evidence. The drag delivery separately passed real AS2/AS3 browser drags, invisible donor margin, child/disabled targeting, outside release and fresh Restart callbacks; existing linked-card Canvas and keyboard activation also passed. Native capture-at-Restart and cursor values retain controlled-helper evidence. Full declaration promotion remains a separate audit. Independent 01f2261 evidence (POINTER-HTML5-20261027T1113Z) is restricted to the real drag/drop, child/disabled targeting, outside-release and Restart observations in VERIFICATION.md. The actual AS3 parent is unrotated and AS2 parent is −4 degrees, both scale 1. Cursor effects, active-capture Restart, lockCenter, active bounds mutation, arbitrary donor/transform/cancellation cases and every nested hit path were not independently accepted. The linked regression has successful body/key controls plus one unresolved first coordinate miss; it is not complete nested-target coverage. AS2 numeric dragging reaches the observed bounded positions and named /legacyRig/dock path; outside release leaves an empty drop path even with a positive bounds hit. Historical target/coercion semantics remain separate. Color is a bounded object-target facade; string paths, missing targets, native subclassing and full legacy coercion are explicitly unsupported. This hour's batch remains partial; acceptance and any observed failures are recorded separately in docs/AS-RUNTIME-HOUR.md. Earlier browser evidence does not certify the new entries or full historical conformance. The second runtime-hour delivery is partial and has representative family HTML5 acceptance, not per-declaration or original-player conformance; see docs/AS-RUNTIME-HOUR-2.md. Displacement remains BitmapData-only: live DisplayObject.filters rejects it. Seeded noise and integer clipping are bounded deterministic profiles, not exact Flash raster parity. The new text/input profiles do not establish arbitrary unload ordering, multi-touch or historical tab/focus conformance.

features.title: Events and handlers
features.scope: Authored handlers and onEnterFrame/onPress callbacks include live inherited AS2 prototype lookup. Captured Key/Mouse/Stage singletons provide object listeners, keyboard state, mouse visibility and logical resize with snapshot/reset/lifetime cleanup. Pointer capture and outside release share the drag lifecycle; AS2 gains onRelease/onReleaseOutside/onRollOver/onRollOut, and mouse target flags/cursor preferences are resolved against the current Rust display graph. Four callback timer globals support function callbacks and the AS2 object/method-name form, cancellation, argument forwarding and Restart cleanup through Rust-owned IDs and the existing scheduler. AsBroadcaster adds five entries: initialize, addListener, removeListener, broadcastMessage and a read-only _listeners snapshot, backed by ordered Rust listener identities. Scripted Tween callbacks use the same publication event/timer facilities. The bounded AS2-only delivery and exact declaration profiles are recorded in docs/AS2-PLATFORM-BATCH.md. Source on/onClipEvent blocks now lower supported event names to the publication bridge. Explicit AS2 preferences control enabled/focus/tab behavior; focused key callbacks, registered on-stage mouse callbacks, drag boundary transitions and bounded runtime unload delivery are connected. The two-hour display example records actual pointer/A/Tab traces without claiming every event ordering.
features.limitations: Other native callbacks, broader Selection behavior, toggled-key/cross-domain/IME behavior and exact Flash lifecycle ordering remain pending. ASCII/layout and logical Stage resize are bounded browser profiles; representative coordinate clicks, keyboard and Restart passed in the AS2 browser batch. Independent a3fedc3 browser evidence covers the specific class/input scenarios in VERIFICATION.md; all untested members remain bounded or unverified. Independent c10e19e evidence (FORMS-HTML5-20261027T0811Z) adds only the actual direct-object Selection and note-field focus/blur/change identities, with one fresh callback after Restart. It does not establish every legacy focus route or general IME behavior. This family has separate grouped input/drag verification; exact historical event ordering, all native-text/semantic combinations, multi-touch and other browser engines remain unverified. The drag delivery separately passed real AS2/AS3 browser drags, invisible donor margin, child/disabled targeting, outside release and fresh Restart callbacks; existing linked-card Canvas and keyboard activation also passed. Native capture-at-Restart and cursor values retain controlled-helper evidence. Full declaration promotion remains a separate audit. Independent 01f2261 evidence (POINTER-HTML5-20261027T1113Z) is restricted to the real drag/drop, child/disabled targeting, outside-release and Restart observations in VERIFICATION.md. The actual AS3 parent is unrotated and AS2 parent is −4 degrees, both scale 1. Cursor effects, active-capture Restart, lockCenter, active bounds mutation, arbitrary donor/transform/cancellation cases and every nested hit path were not independently accepted. The linked regression has successful body/key controls plus one unresolved first coordinate miss; it is not complete nested-target coverage. Observed receiver-bound press/release/outside/rollover counts are limited to this scenario. The source release callbacks explicitly call stopDrag. Callback timers retain bounded delays, IDs, argument counts and active registrations; removed-MovieClip cancellation and exact Flash catch-up timing are not claimed. AsBroadcaster is bounded to 1,024 initialized targets and listeners per target in the host profile; direct _listeners mutation, arbitrary primitive listeners and full broadcaster conformance remain unsupported. Its new browser acceptance is pending in the hour report. This hour's batch remains partial; acceptance and any observed failures are recorded separately in docs/AS-RUNTIME-HOUR.md. Earlier browser evidence does not certify the new entries or full historical conformance. onClipEvent key broadcasts and keyPress source filters remain unsupported. Existing explicit Mouse/Key singleton registration suppresses duplicate implicit delivery for that object; exact Flash overlapping-registration ordering is unverified.

features.title: Programmatic drawing
features.scope: Runtime MovieClips expose solid/linear/radial gradient fill and stroke with native Matrix values and percentage alpha through the shared Rust scene. Lines, quadratic paths, clear and existing dynamic identity behavior remain available.
features.limitations: Initial gradients support pad/rgb, 1..15 ordered stops, copied finite invertible matrices and focal ratios within -1..1. Authored-owner drawing, hairlines, non-round stroke modes, bitmap fills, alpha masks/filters, native gradient tools and full historical paint/coercion semantics remain pending. features.title: TextField and text APIs
features.scope: Plain authored and runtime-created text fields share Rust text/layout state: AS2 createTextField at append-only depth and captured global TextFormat, with getNewTextFormat/setNewTextFormat aliases. Independent logical boxes, multiline/wordWrap, left/center/right alignment, uniform font/size/color/bold/italic/leading, separate current/insertion defaults, text/append/replace and UTF-16 line queries/metrics. Scripted HTML5 input adds native browser editing, Rust revision-checked user transactions, UTF-16 selection/replacement, user-only restrict/maxChars and password masking. AS3 TextFieldType/TextEvent/FocusEvent and AS2 Selection/onChanged/focus callbacks share Stage focus and publication lifetime. The bounded AS2-only delivery and exact declaration profiles are recorded in docs/AS2-DISPLAY-BATCH.md. The two-hour batch adds uniform html/htmlText/styleSheet/condenseWhite, primitive TextField.StyleSheet records and CSS parsing/loading, rendered margin/indent/underline fields and getTextExtent. Real static-text snapshots expose UTF-16 text, selection and geometry. Background/border/scroll/hscroll and bounds share Rust layout and browser editing surfaces; TextField listeners reuse the Rust broadcaster. The ordinary display example passed 41/41 plus physical input.
features.limitations: Whole-field formatting only; differing insertion defaults cannot append/partially replace nonempty text without mixed-run support. Beyond the new uniform HTML/CSS and margin/indent profile, embedded fonts, arbitrary rich paragraph formats, justified alignment and native text subclass initialization remain unsupported. Text is bounded to 1 MiB UTF-8 per field, 16 MiB runtime override storage and 16,384 layout segments/lines, with complete Unicode replacement ranges. Long-token wrapping uses Unicode scalar boundaries, not grapheme segmentation. Installed-font measurements and shared Rust wrapping do not establish Flash layout/coercion parity. The earlier collection/text browser scenario retains its bounded evidence; the new text-layout ordinary-export/real-WASM workflow passes creation, reflow, independent formats, drawing/clip consumption, atomic mixed-run refusal and Restart. The in-app-browser workflow visibly passed reflow/alignment, independent fields and Restart; native interactive editing remains pending. Independent fba17ae evidence (TEXT-LAYOUT-HTML5-20261027T0409Z) covers only the actual uniform layout/format/refusal/Restart workflow in VERIFICATION.md. Native live editing, other fonts/engines, mixed runs and input/IME do not inherit the browser pass. The separate text-form delivery records current scripted input evidence; earlier layout evidence is unchanged. The active DOM field follows affine/vector clipping but is above foreground Canvas artwork. Native input-field authoring, full IME/locale/grapheme/original-player behavior, rich text and cross-engine metrics remain pending; AS2 general string target resolution is unsupported. Independent c10e19e evidence (FORMS-HTML5-20261027T0811Z) covers the observed direct-object Selection focus/range/caret route, note-field onSetFocus/onKillFocus/onChanged identities, real replacement input and saved reload/Restart in examples/text-form.nflash. Password/selectable modes, IME, general target-path resolution, transformed/clipped overlays and native authoring remain unverified. Mixed rich runs remain rejected. CSS/HTML supports only the documented bounded uniform profile; unsupported render properties and malformed input diagnose atomically. Snapshot geometry uses browser font measurements with approximate kerning. The new runtime text profile does not merge or accept the separate paused native TextField checkpoint.

features.title: Audio, video and resource loading
features.scope: Authored embedded PNG/JPEG image placements use shared Rust decoding. BitmapData supports construction, pixel reads/writes, fillRect/copyPixels, clone/scroll and disposal over the shared pixel arena. AS2 exact BitmapData import, rectangle alias and append-depth MovieClip.attachBitmap share that buffer profile. Captured AS2 Sound supports non-streaming loadSound, seconds-based start, owned-channel stop, percentage volume/pan, byte counts and receiver-bound load/completion callbacks. Shared MP3/WAV preflight and publication-owned Web Audio lifecycle gate playback on user activation. File-video playback now adds local NetConnection/NetStream with embedded/native HTTP sources, metadata/status, playback controls and publication cleanup. AS2 uses authored Video.attachVideo, onStatus/onMetaData and pause(flag?); it has no ordinary Video constructor. The bounded AS2-only delivery and exact declaration profiles are recorded in docs/AS2-PLATFORM-BATCH.md. The two-hour AS2 batch adds exact bundled BitmapData.loadBitmap resource IDs and bounded pixel/displacement operations. Sound attachSound resolves exact MP3/WAV resource IDs; Rust parses bounded ID3 text metadata and owns four-coefficient channel-matrix/pan/volume rules. Existing Web Audio nodes apply those gains to live channels. The ordinary Sound example observed two ID3 notifications, silent playback/completion and resource reattachment.
features.limitations: Image loading has a separate bounded PNG/JPEG Loader record. Broader image-loader formats/security/timing, imported SWF/FLA BitmapData linkage, unsupported draw/filter options, shaders and AS2 encoding, bitmap fills, alpha masks, lock/unlock and native Bitmap/BitmapData subclasses remain unsupported. Pixel adapters require integer coordinates/uint colors; historical error/coercion/rasterization fidelity is not claimed. The combined bitmap-pixels ordinary-export/real-WASM scenario passes original PNG decoding, shared/independent buffers, both dialects, actual RGBA uploads, smoothing/snapping, disposal and Restart. The in-app-browser workflow visibly passed shared edits, source/clone independence, AS2 attachment and Restart; native image-panel interaction remains pending. Disposed/invalid access uses shared errors, not historical AS2 numeric sentinel values; Flash depth replacement is unsupported. Dimensions are bounded to 4096 per side, 256 buffer records per publication and 128 MiB live pixels; disposal releases bytes but keeps its record until Restart. Native PNG/JPEG placement is implemented with UI acceptance pending; other image formats remain storage only. Independent 1bd0e3c evidence (BITMAP-HTML5-20261027T0345Z) is restricted to the PNG/shared pixel, AS2 attachment, disposal and Restart observations in VERIFICATION.md. JPEG, rasterization options, alpha hits and native image authoring do not inherit that pass. Audio is a bounded browser profile, not full Flash mixing/coercion: no streaming, SoundLoaderContext, unrestricted ID3/sampleData/extract, mixer/target hierarchy, native audio subclasses or timeline audio authoring. Limits are 128 MiB decoded/pending PCM, 32 channels and 256 Sound owners. One original-MP3 ordinary-export/real-WASM scenario passes transport/preflight, silent gesture scheduling, transforms, callbacks/stop/close and Restart with an injected AudioContext; A separate main-delivery in-app-browser pass verifies actual MP3 decoding/offline PCM, silent native lifecycle and the ordinary AS2/AS3 Play/Stop/Restart workflow; WAV native decode and historical mixer fidelity remain unverified. Independent d8f580a evidence (AUDIO-HTML5-20261027T0429Z) covers only the embedded-AS3/HTTP-AS2 original-MP3 workflow, silent native completion with bounded repeats, transform copy/refusal, active Stop and publication Restart in VERIFICATION.md. It does not inherit the separate main-delivery offline PCM probe or establish audible quality, native WAV decoding, nonzero offsets/gain, full mixer semantics or pending-decode races. Independent 6f4f66a evidence (IMAGE-PIPELINE-HTML5-20261027T0943Z) covers the initial AS2 clone/copy/colorTransform/Blur/applyFilter/draw path through the same AS3-created BitmapData facade and the observed visible panel. It does not establish independently created AS2-origin data, all return/error contracts or later complete console/PNG traces; the bounded source and UI evidence is separated in VERIFICATION.md. Video remains bounded to browser-supported finite files; RTMP/camera/publishing/DRM/FLV, full historical buffer/seek/mixing behavior and native decode/timeline synchronization remain outside this delivery. Decoder/pixel evidence is separate from the controlled host adapter. The Video delivery separately passed one actual-browser AS2/AS3 MP4 workflow: metadata, changing pixels, paused-frame retention, seek/resume/completion, Close retention, local HTTP playback and Restart. The tiny silent fixture does not establish progressive-before-download completion, audible quality, other codecs/engines or native authoring UI. Independent f42ad94 evidence (VIDEO-HTML5-20261027T1042Z) covers the observed embedded AS3/AS2 four-second MP4, native metadata/status/pixels, pause/seek/resume/natural completion, post-completion Close retention, AS3-only clear and active AS2 HTTP Restart/fresh playback in VERIFICATION.md. The negative AS3 seek preserves time; the unsupported-pan diagnostic does not implement panning. Configured volume zero and silent AAC are not audible-effect evidence. Active/pending close, arbitrary rebinding/reentry, smoothing comparisons, other codecs, large progressive/range/CORS transport, exact synchronization and native Video authoring do not inherit this pass. AS2 ID3 supports documented v1/v1.1 and v2.3/v2.4 text/comment/URL subsets; unsupported versions, unsynchronization and selected frame features diagnose. Matrix percentages are bounded, not historical overflow/amplification semantics. Audible balance/quality was not assessed by the silent browser scenario.

features.title: Networking, storage and external communication
features.scope: Captured AS2 LoadVars with decode/toString, erased annotations, byte counters, GET load, GET/POST sendAndLoad, request headers and actual-receiver onData/onLoad/onHTTPStatus callbacks. Embedded version-3 project resources resolve offline; external HTTP(S) uses browser fetch/CORS. Cancellation and publication reset suppress obsolete work. MovieClipLoader adds resource/HTTP PNG/JPEG loadClip, listener callbacks, getProgress and unloadClip with true non-root MovieClip content replacement. Local SharedObject adds getLocal/data/flush/clear and size/getSize over origin/path-scoped browser storage, using real AMF0/AMF3 data and publication-owned wrappers. AS2 ExternalInterface adds same-page synchronous calls and explicit-receiver callbacks; getURL and LoadVars.send add native GET/form POST navigation. The bounded AS2-only delivery and exact declaration profiles are recorded in docs/AS2-XML-DATA-BATCH.md. The two-hour batch adds global/timeline loadVariables and level-zero loadVariablesNum with Rust UTF-8/form decoding, receiver-bound onData and replacement/reset cancellation; the ordinary example passed 4/4 including a real HTTP POST. FileReference/FileReferenceList use actual browser-selected File objects, real available metadata, Rust multipart upload assembly and supported File System Access saves. The browser selected the 35-byte authored fixture and the local server validated the multipart upload; Restart cleared references.
features.limitations: Bounded UTF-8/form profile and browser transport semantics, not complete Flash networking/security/error conformance. Native subclasses, arbitrary filesystem loading, unrestricted multipart uploads, sockets, URLStream, remote SharedObject, automatic retry/timeout policy remain unsupported. Limits: 16 MiB body/response, 64 MiB active response bytes, 32 concurrent operations, 1024 form pairs and 64 request headers. One combined ordinary-export/real-WASM resource-loading scenario passed embedded data, emitted AS3/AS2 HTTP POST through actual local fetch, cancellation and Restart. The embedded pipeline, same-origin HTTP GET and Restart passed in the in-app browser. Native resource-panel and direct-file browser opening remain pending; cross-origin browser CORS was not separately exercised. Independent c39a29e acceptance (RESOURCES-HTML5-20261027T0323Z) covers the precise embedded/HTTP and pending-request observations in VERIFICATION.md; native resource authoring and full network semantics remain unverified. Image loading excludes SWF/GIF, application/security domains, native Loader subclasses and general legacy target addressing. Retained AS3 content survives unload; explicit disposal/Restart and shared arena limits apply while full garbage collection remains pending. The loader-gallery delivery has separate evidence; previous resource/bitmap audits do not promote new loader declarations. Independent 039afe6 evidence (LOADER-HTML5-20261027T0709Z) covers only the direct MovieClipLoader embedded-PNG/HTTP-JPEG gallery, observed complete-before-init and metadata, target input, replacement/unload-to-empty and Restart in VERIFICATION.md. General legacy addressing, return/error behavior and unobserved callbacks do not inherit that pass. This persistence/codec delivery has separate evidence. Typed aliases/class reconstruction, externalizable/XML/Vector/Dictionary values, native .sol files and remote synchronization remain pending. Browser quota/access and HTTP(S) origin rules apply; Restart discards unflushed edits. AMF payload size excludes the storage envelope and historical filesystem overhead. Independent eddcc30 evidence (STORAGE-AMF-HTML5-20261027T0728Z) covers only the observed AS2 saved-game graph, actual reload/Restart, two-path isolation and clear workflow in VERIFICATION.md. AS3/AS2 data-object identity and flush-return scopes remain separate; equal reported sizes do not prove all storage bytes unchanged. The original malformed-AMF typed-catch failure and separate positive control retain distinct provenance. Quota/security/concurrent-tab/native storage behavior is not accepted. Web-container integration has a separate bounded profile: browser policies, copied plain data, HTTP(S) navigation and publication-owned callbacks; no desktop/plugin security-domain or unload-delivery guarantee. Web-integration delivery evidence separately covers synchronous page/project callbacks, real named-frame GET/form POST and Restart in the in-app browser; AS3 response-free POST has a real server receipt. Other engines, cross-origin/popup variations and original-player behavior remain unverified. FileReference requires actual user gestures and browser capabilities; no arbitrary filesystem paths, creationDate or Macintosh creator codes are invented. Native-save download was not executed in the delivery browser check. The multi-file chooser capability was observed with one selected file, not a multi-selection transfer. Upload progress is truthful start/completion progress because fetch does not expose incremental upload bytes.

features.scope: The bounded runtime component profile includes existing mx.transitions easing/Tween and AS2 component event helpers. The two-hour batch adds nonvisual Collection/Iterator/DataProvider/DataSet/local-delta families, primitive EndPoint/Binding/ComponentMixins/DataType/TypedValue services and mx.lang.Locale translation tables/XLIFF loading. features.title: XML
features.scope: XML/XMLNode constructors and strict shared Rust parsing; DOM traversal, individual attributes/text, clone/move/remove, serialization and namespace preservation. XML.load reuses URLLoader with legacy callbacks/byte counters and publication lifetime. The bounded AS2-only delivery and exact declaration profiles are recorded in docs/AS2-XML-DATA-BATCH.md.
features.limitations: This is a bounded XML1.0 UTF-8 profile, separate from XFL parsing. DTD/custom entities, declaration/namespace mutation, send/sendAndLoad and full legacy status/coercion/partial-tree recovery remain unsupported. Strict syntax/namespace/character failure sets -6 and preserves prior content; other unsupported forms diagnose. Detached nodes count against publication bounds until Restart. Combined delivery evidence does not imply independent per-declaration audit or original-player conformance. Independent f4fcb71 evidence (XML-HTML5-20261027T0545Z) covers only the actual embedded-resource tree/catalog workflow, full logical-tree comparisons, copy/mutation/serialization and Restart in VERIFICATION.md. It does not imply byte-identical serialization syntax, full historical parser/coercion behavior or later E4X syntax.
